items.statement: Cross-repository manifests may contain incomplete, contradictory or ambiguously owned capability declarations.
items.feature: Workspace uncertainty aggregation, provider conflict diagnostics and evidence-gated resolution planning
items.unknown_behavior: Do not generate an execution plan when required capabilities are unresolved or multiple providers are ambiguous.
verification: Every repository-local uncertainty registry validates against the common contract.
Workspace plans are stable regardless of repository input order.
Duplicate repository IDs and duplicate uncertainty IDs are rejected.
Implemented items stay open until acceptance evidence exists.
